changelog:
Initial release of AI大模型专家｜短剧分集梗概 (v1.0.0)

- Provides episode synopsis, outline, storyboarding, and execution tools for short drama and manhua creation teams.
- Supports streamlined workflows for scriptwriting, image/video asset generation, and commercial delivery across domestic and overseas short drama platforms.
- Features task management, version control, and real-time AI model configuration via AI-HIVE.
- Includes best practice guidance for project planning, prompt writing, and task validation.
- Emphasizes content quality, copyright compliance, and safe usage for commercial scenarios.
